column1: # mapping_set_title: DDI-CDI to CDIF profile classes and properties

# mapping_set_description: Class and attribute crosswalks from DDI-CDI 1.1beta to the five CDIF profiles (Codelist, Core, Discovery, DataDescription, DataStructure). Generated from ucmism2m mapping configurations.

column11: Class semantics align. Attribute vocabulary is SKOS + CDIF rather than DDI-CDI.
Class name matches; attribute vocabulary is SKOS rather than DDI-CDI structured types.
schema:Dataset is broader than DDI-CDI DataStore; DataStore in DDI-CDI excludes the metadata-about-the-dataset semantics that schema:Dataset implies. Mapping is conceptual only.
DataDownload is the schema.org expression of a downloadable physical realization of a dataset.
Conceptually similar; DDI-CDI AgentInRole is a DataType so cannot be sourceClass.
DefinedTerm is a flat schema.org notion; DDI-CDI Concept is richer (placed in a ConceptSystem).
